items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. Exploitation attempts have been detected in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.
